description: Full detail for one publication by its id (the slug from search_placements), including price, price with the 3.5% checkout processing fee, authority scores, estimated monthly traffic (monthlyTraffic), turnaround, disclosure policy, link type (linkAttributes: "dofollow" or "nofollow" as recorded, "unspecified" where the catalog has no record; dofollowVariantId points to a separate dofollow package for the same outlet), genres (what the outlet covers), niches (restricted subjects it accepts) with nichePricing where an article in one is priced differently, labels (e.g. Staff, Press Release, 6 Month Lifespan), whether it can be ordered now (available), the outlet's logo, and an example article where one is published. A field the catalog has no value for is left out: unknown, not "no".
name: get_placement
title: Get placement detail
